A paixão por esportes é indiscutível. Mas o que realmente nos move é transformar a forma como o esporte é consumido , combinando criatividade, tecnologia, dados e execução em alta velocidade. Na LiveMode , desenvolvemos soluções digitais que conectam clubes, federações, ligas, atletas e marcas ao público de forma relevante, autêntica e inovadora. Nosso objetivo é construir um ecossistema que sustente o esporte nas próximas décadas, integrando o melhor do digital, das redes sociais e da TV .

Com essa visão de futuro, estamos formando um Banco de Talentos para profissionais que desejam atuar como Produtor(a) de Conteúdos – Redes Sociais , jogando junto ao nosso time de Conteúdo , com oportunidades no Rio de Janeiro (100% Presencial) .   • Planejar, produzir e publicar conteúdos para redes sociais, garantindo consistência editorial, agilidade e alinhamento com a estratégia de cada projeto.

  • Trabalhar em parceria com times de Design, Audiovisual, Produto e Comercial, transformando ideias, pautas e dados em conteúdo relevante para diferentes plataformas.

  • Experiência prévia com produção de conteúdo para redes sociais, seja em veículos de mídia, projetos digitais, marcas ou criadores.

  • Open English oferece acesso a cursos de inglês ou espanhol em diversos formatos, com descontos exclusivos para colaboradores e familiares.

Nossa cultura

Na LiveMode, nossa missão é Transformar e Crescer o Esporte, e nossos valores são o combustível que nos move no dia a dia. Acreditamos que crescer exige inconformismo, ambição e consistência. Nossa cultura nasce disso: de gente que não aceita o que está aí, que quer fazer mais, aprender mais e entregar mais — sempre com responsabilidade e visão de futuro. Quem está na LiveMode está aqui para marcar a história do esporte no Brasil e no Mundo.

SOMOS EMPREENDEDORES ontem, hoje e sempre. Escolhemos o gol e corremos atrás dele com tudo. Focamos em poucas prioridades e vamos até o fim, sem distrações. Tratamos cada recurso como se fosse nosso, decidindo rápido e com coragem. Comunicação? Direta, aberta e na velocidade do jogo.

SOMOS UM TIME DE ALTA PERFORMANCE não uma família ou uma confraria de amigos. Família a gente não escolhe, mas o time escolhe quem joga. E quando o jogo é grande, não dá pra carregar quem não tá entregando. Aqui, a gente decide pelo que é melhor pra empresa, não pra uma área ou pessoa. Toda entrega tem um dono claro, que vai até o fim. Processos ajudam, mas não mandam: quem resolve são as pessoas.

SOMOS AMBICIOSOS pensamos sempre grande. A gente já fez muita coisa grande. Mas quem está na LiveMode sabe que dá pra ir além. Porque quem é ambicioso de verdade vive com a sensação de que sempre dá pra melhorar, crescer, fazer mais impacto. Aqui, a ambição não é discurso. É prática. E é ela que nos leva a quebrar recorde atrás de recorde.

O QUE NOS MOVE É O FUTURO . Na LiveMode, o futuro já está em movimento — e quem não acompanha, fica pra trás. Por isso, tratamos tecnologia com urgência: testamos, aprendemos e aplicamos com velocidade. Queremos ser uma empresa IA first, porque acreditamos que dominar essas ferramentas não é opcional — é o que vai nos ajudar a alcançar nossa missão mais rápido. IA não é extra. É parte central do nosso dia a dia.

title: AIDS 2026 Prevention Ambassador Fellowship (Fully Funded)
description:
AIDS 2026 Prevention Ambassador Fellowship (Fully Funded)

The AIDS 2026 Prevention Ambassador Fellowship is a prestigious international fellowship organised by the (IAS) . The fellowship supports digital creators, advocates, and professionals working to advance HIV prevention knowledge, access, and community engagement , with full participation at AIDS 2026 in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

The programme combines funding, global exposure, professional development, and international travel for selected fellows.

Scholarship Details

  • Host: International AIDS Society (IAS)
  • Event: AIDS 2026 – 26th International AIDS Conference
  • Conference Dates: 25 – 30 July 2026
  • Fellowship Period: March 2026 – 14 August 2026
  • Application Deadline: 15 February 2026 (23:00 CET)
  • Financial support of up to USD 500 for a digital HIV prevention content project before AIDS 2026
  • Financial support of up to USD 500 for a digital content project during AIDS 2026
  • Full support to attend AIDS 2026 in person , including:
    • International travel
    • Accommodation
    • Per diem
    • Ground transportation (where applicable)
  • Opportunity to:
    • Amplify HIV prevention messaging globally
    • Translate scientific and policy discussions into accessible digital content
    • Network with researchers, policymakers, activists, and global health leaders
  • Participation in professional development, networking, and advocacy activities

Applicants must meet all of the following:

  • Be 18 years or older at the time of application
  • Have a proven track record in advancing HIV prevention knowledge or access (e.g. PrEP, PEP, U=U, harm reduction, policy, long-acting prevention)
  • Demonstrate content creation experience on HIV prevention through:
    • Social or digital platforms (TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook, X, Bluesky)
    • Podcasts, blogs, newsletters, or community radio
  • Have a minimum reach of 5,000 total followers/subscribers across platforms , OR documented community reach and engagement
  • Commit to ethical, evidence-based, non-stigmatizing, rights-based communication
  • Virtual pre-event onboarding

Priority Will Be Given To Applicants Who:

  • Represent or work closely with key and priority populations, including:
    • People living with HIV
    • Men who have sex with men
    • Trans people
    • Sex workers
    • People who inject drugs
    • Adolescent girls and young women
    • Migrants and underserved communities
  • Are based in low- and middle-income countries
  • Produce content for underserved audiences
  • Have experience collaborating with community-led organisations, clinics, or advocacy coalitions
  • Descriptions of two digital HIV prevention communication projects :
    • One to be implemented before AIDS 2026
    • One to be implemented during AIDS 2026
  • For each project:
    • Intended outcomes
    • Planned themes
    • Target audiences
    • Platforms to be used
    • Two sample posts showing how the project would look
  • Portfolio and/or links to recent prevention-related digital content (last 6–12 months)
  • Evidence of reach (screenshots of analytics or engagement metrics)
  • Letter of support (if employed)
  • Letter of reference (if self-employed)

Deadline

  • Application Closes: 15 February 2026 at 23:00 CET

Late or incomplete applications will not be considered.

  • Download and complete the official AIDS 2026 Prevention Ambassador Fellowship application form
  • Prepare all required documents and project descriptions
  • Submit your application before the deadline

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. All application information will be treated confidentially.

FAQs

Is this a fully funded opportunity? Yes. Selected fellows receive funding for digital projects and full support to attend AIDS 2026 in Brazil.

Do I need to be a medical professional? No. Applicants may be content creators, advocates, researchers, community workers, or digital communicators with proven HIV prevention engagement.

Can social media creators apply? Yes. Creators on platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, blogs, podcasts, and community media are encouraged to apply.

Is English mandatory? Yes. English proficiency is required to engage with AIDS 2026 content and communications.

Can applicants from Africa apply? Yes. Applicants from low- and middle-income countries, including African countries, are strongly encouraged to apply.

title: Senior Investment Analyst
description:
Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Join Howard University and thrive with us! We are searching for a Senior Investment Analyst who will be responsible for research and analytical duties surrounding the Endowment and Retirement Trust. Outputs of analysis will include preparation of reporting materials such as asset allocation, evaluating performance of existing managers, preparation of cash balances and interaction with custodian. Howard University Investment Office is responsible for the management of the Endowment/Investment Pool and the Retirement Trust totaling an aggregated AUM over $1.6 billion in accordance with Board of Trustee approved investment policy and asset allocation. The University has benefited from tremendous leadership by the President and Senior Administration in attracting world-class students and faculty and positioning the University in the short and long-term. The growth in Endowment supports these efforts and the Retirement Trust funding ratio is the highest in its recent history. Senior Investment Analyst will be supportive of the Chief Investment and Deputy Chief Investment Officer, primarily accountable for ongoing performance analysis, documentation, and reporting activities of the Investment Office related to the selection, monitoring and oversight of the Endowment\'s external investment managers. This role is heavily involved in the office\'s data collection and retention process. In addition to working closely with members of the investment team, this role will interact with other University departments and external entities including the Endowment\'s investment managers and administrators, custodian bank, and auditors. The Senior Investment Operations Analyst will be responsible for producing high quality work, including material that is readily presentable to constituencies inside and outside of the Investment Office.

Nature And Scope

The investment portfolio invests in diversified asset classes including domestic and international equities, domestic and global bonds, Inflation Hedging and Alternative strategies such as hedge funds, private equity and real assets. The Endowment and Retirement Funds uses external investment managers through commingled vehicles, separate accounts, trusts and limited partnerships. Manager selection, diligence and asset class assumptions accomplished with assistance of consultants and other partners.

Operational

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES:

  • Oversee with the CIO and DCIO, the investment portfolio and related projects including cash reconciliation, return and risk calculations, documentation requests, workflow details with Treasury.
  • Take ownership of pacing analysis and capital call adherence

Investment Operations For Risk Management And Performance Attribution

  • Responsible for the selection, development and maintenance of the analytics system for research management and investment performance attribution and risk management. Work with the Information Services Department as a partner, when appropriate
  • Work to ensure that all documents and contracts secure the rights and property of the University.

Administration

  • Help create materials for Investment Committee meetings
  • Participate, in a general sense, as a team member of the Howard University Investment Office.

Investment Research, Manager Due Diligence And Fund Selection

  • Evaluate current and recommend new investment managers
  • Perform statistical analysis and general research related to the capital markets for purposes of defining options for continuous investment improvements and recommendations for tactical strategies within asset classes to enhance performance of the overall portfolio
  • Analyze investment performance and investment related issues and prepare material for the CIO and presentations (verbal and written) to the Investment Committee.
  • Review all footnotes of all presentation materials of external manager investments
  • Review appropriateness of investment fees and costs and recommend reductions

Projects

  • Perform periodic studies, such as benchmarking on different investment issues, and manage projects as assigned.

Other Duties

  • As assigned

Core Competencies

  • Advanced excel modeling
  • Investment Banking or institutional finance training
  • Significant written and oral communication skills
  • Ability to deliver accurate deliverables
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Ability to work independently, identify problems, priorities, solutions
  • Knowledge of investment portfolio theory and process of manager evaluation and selection

Professional Development

  • Enhance professional growth by participating in educational programs and professional organizations and activities to maintain knowledge of national and international trends and to promote edge performance and expertise.
  • Attend conferences and seminars to enhance understanding of current operational issues, which impact portfolio and investment results. Network with other endowments and foundations to learn of investment programs, strategies and systems which may be applicable to Howard University.

Minimum Requirements

Requires a minimum of 10 years of endowment, foundation or investment experience; skills in both written and oral communication; knowledge of investment concepts in a broad range of asset classes. The ideal candidate would possess deep knowledge of equity and fixed income strategies, CFA designation, MBA in Finance, and experience in private markets would be preferred.

At Metricool, we’re looking for a Social Media Manager & Content Creator to own and manage our social media presence in Brazil, one of our most strategic growth markets.

You’ll work 100% remotely in an international, fast-growing company, with a team that thrives on collaboration, creativity, and analytical thinking.

Your mission is to make Metricool relevant and recognizable in Brazil through social media. You’ll do this by adapting and publishing global content for the local market, managing our day-to-day social media presence, and creating video-first content that reflects Brazilian culture and trends.

Content Creator

  • Adapt global social media campaigns, launches, and evergreen content to the Brazilian market, ensuring cultural relevance and a local tone.
  • Research and propose native content ideas based on Brazilian social media trends, memes, creator formats, and platform-specific behaviors.
  • Write and adapt captions in Brazilian Portuguese, aligned with Metricool’s brand voice and messaging guidelines.
  • Act as a brand representative on camera, recording educational, promotional, and trend-based content.
  • Record short-form video content (TikTok & Instagram Reels) on a weekly basis.
  • Create occasional long-form video content (tutorials, feature explanations, or campaign support).

Social Media Manager

  • Manage and grow Metricool’s Brazilian social media channels, mainly Instagram and LinkedIn.
  • Schedule and publish content according to the local content calendar.
  • Monitor performance and identify which formats, topics, and narratives resonate most with the Brazilian audience.
  • Engage with the community by responding to comments and relevant interactions when needed.
  • Share insights, trends, and performance learnings with the global marketing team to inform experimentation and strategy.

First days at Metricool

  • First month: For the first few weeks, we will ensure you understand your impact on the team and the business and learn about the team, the industry, and processes. You will meet every contributor on your team and understand their areas of expertise.
  • First Quarter: Within the first three months, you will understand your team better, work autonomously, and begin sharing new ideas and creating a more significant impact.
  • To the moon: After this process, you will become an active team member. You will also understand how to reach objectives and set your strategies based on the company's goals.

Job requirements

  • Must be located in Brazil.
  • Experience: 3-5 years of previous experience in a Social Media Management & Content Creation role.
  • Education: Degree in Digital Marketing or a similar field.
  • Languages: Native Portuguese, advanced English. Advanced level in Spanish is a plus.

Hard skills

  • Strong experience managing social media accounts professionally.
  • Proven experience creating short-form, mobile-first video content.
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian social media culture, trends and creators ecosystems.

Soft skills

  • Strong storytelling and on-camera presence.
  • Creative mindset with a strong sense of cultural relevance.
  • Ability to translate global brand messaging into local content.
  • Proactivity, autonomy, and ownership.
  • Flexibility and willingness to experiment and iterate.

Why you will fall in love with Metricool

  • Remote Work Environment: Team members have the flexibility to work from any location of their choice. All processes are designed to accommodate remote work, fostering inclusivity and communication through platforms like Slack or Meets.
  • Annual Meetups: Once a year, we organize an event to bring the team together, fostering camaraderie and mutual understanding.
  • Competitive Salary: We are actively working to align our budgets with market standards, offering highly competitive salary packages. The salary band for this position is between 4500 BRL and 9000 BRL gross per month.
  • Professional Development Plan: Recognizing the desire for personal growth, we provide guidance and support to our team members on their professional journey.
  • English Language Lessons: As an international company, we provide support in English language, as well as other languages in cases when it’s relevant for the role and the team.

Hiring process steps

Canonical is a growing international software company that works with the open‑source community to deliver Ubuntu, "the world's best free software platform". Our services help businesses worldwide to reduce costs, improve efficiency and enhance security with Ubuntu.

title: Cloud Solutions Developer
description:
Conservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.

POSITION SUMMARY

This position has a hybrid working arrangement, working remotely some days and in the office on others. This role can be based in Arlington-VA, Bolivia, Colombia, Peru, Costa Rica, Mexico, Ecuador, Brazil (remote), Belgium, United Kingdom (remote), or Germany (remote).

The Cloud Solutions Developer will lead the design, development, and optimization of the organization’s web and cloud systems. This position combines hands-on technical expertise with strategic leadership, ensuring secure, scalable, and cost-effective solutions that enable our mission globally.

This is a unique opportunity to apply technical skills in a purpose-driven organization where your work will directly support environmental sustainability, community engagement, and global impact.

What We Offer

  • Hybrid work flexibility – giving you the option to work remotely some days and connect in person on others (Fully remote work available in Brazil).
  • The opportunity to contribute your skills to a mission with a tangible global environmental and social impact.
  • A collaborative, multicultural environment with colleagues worldwide.
  • Professional growth through innovative projects, vendor partnerships, and external representation opportunities.

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize web systems built on multiple architectures.
  • Design, develop, and implement cloud-based applications.
  • Collaborate with design, content, infrastructure, and security teams to implement and maintain secure, performant, cost-effective, and scalable cloud-based solutions.
  • Maintain a code repository and provide technical support and troubleshooting for web applications and CMS.
  • Stay up to date with the latest industry trends and technologies to ensure the organization remains at the forefront of web development and cloud computing.

Strategic and Advisory

  • Develop and maintain standards for web application development, hosting, and maintenance.
  • Advise programs on technical components of web application and CMS development.
  • Manage relationships with cloud service providers, including budget and service agreements.
  • Represent the organization externally and serve as a trusted point of contact for technical inquiries.
  • Identify opportunities for technical advancement and innovation within the IT Solutions team.

People & Resource Management

  • Partner with Finance to monitor budgets and spending for web applications and cloud-based solutions.
  • Does not directly supervise staff.

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Flexible work arrangements, including hybrid work options (Remote in Brazil).
  • Occasional travel, as needed.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field.
  • 5 to 7 years of experience in full-stack development and cloud-based solutions.
  • Proficiency in front-end, back-end, and cloud-based technologies (e.g., JavaScript, PHP, Python, Node.js, .Net, AWS/Azure, Craft/Sanity CMS).
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Excellent organization, prioritization, and time management abilities.
  • Ability to work effectively with diverse teams in a multicultural environment.
  • Proven ability to multitask and meet priorities in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and minimal supervision.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Fluency in English (verbal and written) is required.

Preferred

  • Experience working with or managing external vendors.
  • Experience managing budgets for cloud solutions.
  • Experience mentoring or supporting other developers in technical project design and delivery.

title: Telco Cloud Engineer (5G, OpenRan, OpenStack, Python) - Americas
description:
The role of a Telco Field Engineer at Canonical

The telco industry is moving to software‑defined services. This transformation is driven by open source software, cloud computing and the move to VNF / CNF approaches. Canonical Ubuntu is a key platform for telco innovation, and we are growing our team of specialists who work in the industry to accelerate the change.

Canonical enables operators and communications service providers to embrace this new world, with a focus on platforms such as Ubuntu, OpenStack, and Kubernetes, and reusable, high quality automation for operations at scale.

As part of the Canonical Field Engineering organization, you will lead customers through the design and delivery of OpenStack, Kubernetes, and software‑defined networking solutions. Your passion for open‑source technologies will enable customers to understand and operate advanced infrastructure substrates to meet the demands of 5G and beyond. This role is a hands‑on role where you will both design and implement solutions.

Location:

Remote‑based, Americas

What your day will look like

  • Match customer requirements to advanced capabilities in the VNF/CNF/NFVi/NFVO/VNFM/VIM/MEC space
  • Provide technical pre‑sales consulting to Service Provider teams
  • Design and implement telco‑grade open source multi‑tenant private clouds and micro clouds
  • Deploy cloud solutions for our customers (OpenStack, Kubernetes, MAAS and Ceph)
  • Investigate, report and/or fix software defects uncovered during customer deployments
  • Demonstrate advanced Infrastructure as code (IaC) techniques relevant to telco (automation scripting, terraform, etc.)
  • Learn model‑driven operations with Juju charms for Kafka, Hadoop, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, NGINX, and more
  • Help customers adopt advanced Bare Metal, Public, Private and Hybrid Cloud solutions
  • Learn from customer engagements and drive meaningful product improvements
  • Shape our roadmap to accelerate our growth in the telco market

What we are looking for in you

  • Python software development experience (mandatory - intermediate level)
  • Terraform automation experience
  • A thorough understanding of the telco NFVi (VIM), NFVO, VNFM and MEC space
  • Technical understanding of key telco technologies like CPU Pinning, NUMA, SRIOV, DPDK, etc
  • A thorough working understanding of the architectures and infrastructure of MNOs and CSPs
  • Working knowledge of Mobile Packet Core, Radio, VAS, OSS/BSS
  • Understanding of best practices for open source technology in telco virtualisation
  • Working knowledge of Linux, OpenStack and Kubernetes networking
  • A passion to automate and improve all aspects of open source products and tooling
  • Ability to lead complex projects from start to finish
  • A collaborative attitude with a keen eye on customer success
  • Excellent communication and presentation abilities
  • Able to travel up to 50% of the time for events, customer meetings, project delivery

Additional skills that you might also bring

  • Second language
  • Track record of open source contributions

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.

  • Fully remote working environment – we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000 USD per annum
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at sprints
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence – in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote‑first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st‑century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Auxiliar de Enfermagem | Gávea - RJ
description:
Job description

A missão desse cargo será auxiliar na prestação de cuidados aos pacientes em um ambiente hospitalar. Suas principais responsabilidades incluem a assistência direta aos pacientes, a realização de procedimentos técnicos e a colaboração com a equipe de saúde.

Main responsibilities

  • Realizar as rotinas de enfermagem da Instituição (passagem de plantão, registro de intercorrências, notificações de eventos, etc.).
  • Manter o posto de Enfermagem organizado para as atividades laborativas;
  • Receber, conferir, administrar e devolver as medicações prescritas;
  • Executar a Sistematização da Assistência de Enfermagem – Prescrição de Enfermagem e Plano de Cuidados;
  • Realizar os registros seguros da sua prática profissional;
  • Realizar curativo simples e comunicar ao enfermeiro;
  • Preparar o paciente para exames e tratamentos internos e externos, se houver necessidade;
  • Observar, reconhecer e descrever sinais e sintomas, ao nível de sua qualificação, sempre comunicando ao Enfermeiro.
  • Executar tratamentos especificamente prescritos, ou de rotina, além de outras atividades de enfermagem;
  • Ministrar medicamentos por via oral, IM e uso tópico relatando quaisquer alterações e/ou intercorrências ao Enfermeiro responsável;
  • Administrar nebulização, enema e calor ou frio conforme prescrição;
  • Realizar o controle de pacientes e contactantes de doenças transmissíveis, sob a supervisão do Enfermeiro;
  • Colher material (Urina e Fezes) para exames laboratoriais por método convencional;
  • Prestar cuidados de enfermagem pré e pós-procedimentos;
  • Executar atividades de limpeza e desinfecção de materiais;
  • Verificar e registrar sinais vitais para monitorar o estado de saúde dos pacientes, como temperatura, pressão arterial, pulso, respiração e glicemia capilar;
  • Realizar registros precisos das informações dos pacientes, incluindo sinais vitais, medicamentos administrados, procedimentos realizados e observações relevantes sobre o estado do paciente;
  • Apoiar na realização da contenção mecânica;
  • Realizar rondas conforme plano de cuidados;
  • Possuir escuta ativa e sensível;
  • Realizar manejo e abordagem aos pacientes com instabilidade psíquica;
  • Prestar cuidados de higiene e conforto ao paciente;
  • Zelar pela sua segurança, controle de pertences de riscos (giletes, fio dental, removedor esmalte, esmaltes etc.);
  • Auxiliar e incentivar a realização das atividades de vida diárias, tais como higiene pessoal, alimentação, mobilidade e eliminação.
  • Auxiliar no posicionamento dos pacientes confortavelmente na cama e movê-los com segurança quando necessário;
  • Realizar mudança de decúbito em paciente acamado;
  • Atuar sob supervisão do enfermeiro em intercorrências clínicas e psíquicas;
  • Auxiliar e incentivar na organização dos pertences e quarto dos pacientes;
  • Zelar pela limpeza e ordem dos materiais, de equipamentos e de dependências de unidades de saúde;
  • Oferecer apoio emocional aos pacientes, ouvindo suas preocupações e fornecendo conforto sempre que necessário. Buscando sempre um profissional da Equipe multidisciplinar e Enfermeiro em situações de saúde emocionalmente desafiadora;
  • Integrar a equipe de Saúde reportando todos os dados para o enfermeiro responsável pelo setor;
  • Realizar apoio e interação com toda equipe multidisciplinar;
  • Realizar observação contínua aos pacientes e relatar quaisquer alterações aos enfermeiros responsáveis.
  • Participar de atividades em saúde, seguindo prescrição de enfermagem e médica;
  • Auxiliar o Enfermeiro na execução dos programas de Educação para a Saúde;
  • Executar trabalhos de rotina vinculados à alta de pacientes;
  • Participar de procedimentos pós morte;
  • Realizar a coleta venosa e de secreção oro e nasofaringe. Preparo e realização do teste Toxicológico, Covid 19, entre outros testes não invasivos.
  • Entre outras rotinas pertinentes ao cargo.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Ter curso de auxiliar de enfermagem;
  • COREN de AUXILIAR DE ENFERMAGEM ativo;
  • Possuir experiencia em saúde mental será um diferencial.

  • Gympass;
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Vale transporte.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Realizar o recebimento de medicamentos e materiais entregues nas unidades, efetuando o recebimento conforme procedimento operacional padrão estabelecido pela companhia, utilizando instrumento adequado para tal processo;
  • Executar o processo de entrada de notas fiscais no SAP conforme procedimento interno padronizado, com eficiência e dentro dos tempos e movimentos preconizados; Exercer processo de armazenamento dos materiais e medicamentos recebidos conforme boas práticas de armazenamento e procedimentos internos, mantendo os insumos em condições adequadas de uso.
  • Realizar diariamente o processo de dispensação de medicamentos e materiais em atendimento a prescrições médicas ou demais requisições, efetuando todas as etapas descritas em procedimento operacional padrão da atividade, garantindo assim que os medicamentos e materiais solicitados sejam dispensados corretamente, evitando erros de dispensação. Executar o processo de devolução de materiais e medicamentos recolhidos nos postos assistenciais e centro cirúrgico conforme procedimento operacional previamente estabelecido.
  • Realizar diariamente a reposição dos endereçamentos com medicamentos e materiais, realizando todas as etapas descritas em procedimento operacional padrão da atividade, visando garantir a disponibilidade e localização dos medicamentos e materiais, além de realizar todos os atendimentos necessários para reabastecimento das farmácias satélites e setores assistenciais; Realizar diariamente o processo de unitarização de medicamentos e materiais efetuando todas as etapas descritas em procedimento operacional padrão da atividade, visando assegurar que os procedimentos e legislações estejam sendo cumpridas.
  • Verificar mensalmente o prazo de validade dos medicamentos e materiais e anotá‑lo em formulário específico para que os farmacêuticos acompanhem os produtos com prazo de validade expirada ou próximo ao vencimento.
  • Realizar diariamente processo de contagem de medicamentos controlados, conforme recorrência e processos corporativamente estabelecidos;
  • Realizar diariamente a contagem dos medicamentos e materiais da curva ABC, anotando na planilha de contagem o saldo no físico e no sistema informatizado, visando garantir o controle de estoque destes insumos contribuindo para acurácia de estoque;
  • Participar da equipe de inventários sempre que solicitado;
  • Realizar diariamente o processo de montagem de kits de centro cirúrgico, hemodinâmica em atendimento a agenda de cirurgias do dia, seguindo os procedimentos padronizados por diretrizes corporativas;
  • Executar todos os procedimentos pertencentes ao fluxo de materiais especiais (OPME), operacionalizando o sistema INPART de maneira adequada e assegurar execução de todas as etapas corporativamente predefinidas;
  • Realizar a entrega de insumos previamente separados pelas farmácias e almoxarifado para diferentes destinos internos no hospital, desde postos de enfermagem até farmácias satélites;
  • Efetuar diariamente o controle de temperatura (geladeira e ambiente) e controle de umidade, verificando a temperatura e umidade nos termômetros e termohigrômetro e anotando na ficha de controle, visando garantir a temperatura ideal para armazenamento de medicamentos e materiais;
  • Zelar pela conservação dos equipamentos utilizados diariamente, devendo informar ao farmacêutico qualquer necessidade de manutenção ou troca destes, a fim de manter os equipamentos em condições de uso;
  • Zelar diariamente pela limpeza e organização do setor de farmácia e almoxarifado, realizando as atividades diárias de forma que a limpeza e organização sejam mantidas, visando manter o setor limpo e organizado;
  • Cumprir e respeitar as normas e regras instituídas pela empresa, bem como as regras dos órgãos certificadores adotados por esta instituição.

Qualificações Necessárias

  • Ensino Médio completo;
  • Não é requerida experiência anterior comprovada na área;
  • Experiência profissional anterior como auxiliar de farmácia hospitalar será considerado apenas um diferencial;

Há 30 anos, nascemos na Zona Oeste do Rio como uma marca raiz , autêntica como o carioca. Somos o Guaraná Natural mais amado do Rio de Janeiro , e temos orgulho da nossa história de crescimento com os pés no chão, foco em resultado e paixão pelo que fazemos.

Acreditamos que Tudo pode ser feito melhor — nada é definitivo, e evoluir é parte da nossa essência.

A diversidade nos move para frente!

Desde o começo da nossa história, atuamos com valores que promovem um ambiente sempre aberto ao diálogo, onde todas as vozes são escutadas e respeitadas. Acreditamos que poder ser quem nós somos, do jeito que nos sentimos bem, nos ajuda na realização de um bom trabalho, além de criar um maior companheirismo no espaço corporativo e ter motivação para chegar mais longe. Estamos prontos para crescer e assumir ainda mais desafios.

description:
Job description

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Main responsibilities

  • Executar as atividades de limpeza em geral nas dependências internas e externas da Unidade de Saúde, procedendo à retirada de utensílios e materiais;
  • Distribuir materiais de consumo nas diversas áreas e providenciar a reposição quando necessária;
  • Efetuar limpeza terminal em áreas contaminadas, de isolamento e demais dependências dos usuários;
  • Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição;
  • Recolher o lixo da unidade em que serve, acondicionando detritos e depositando-os de acordo com as determinações definidas;
  • Manter arrumado o material sob sua guarda;
  • Remover o pó dos móveis, tetos, portas, janelas e equipamentos, espanando-os ou limpando-os;
  • Limpar escadas, pisos, calçadas, banheiros, copas, varrendo-os, encerando-os ou passando aspirador de pó;
  • Arrumar banheiro, limpando-os com água, sabão, detergente e desinfetante, reabastecendo-os de papel higiênico, toalhas e sabonetes;
  • Executar serviços de limpeza da área externa das Unidades Educativas, varrendo ou lavando calçadas, pátios, paredes, janelas, como também, roçando e capinando;
  • Atender às necessidades de Medicina, Higiene e Segurança do Trabalho;

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Fundamental Incompleto;
  • Experiência mínima de seis meses como Auxiliar de Serviços Gerais.

title: MRV Researcher
description:
InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is simple but bold: to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. Our company culture blends people‑first care and performance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact. We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil — where the real climate impact happens. You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to see how people find interviewing with us. Check out our Culture page here.

About the Role

ON SITE, HYBRID - Piracicaba. Language skills: advanced English + Portuguese.

The impact you can make

  • Advance cutting‑edge ERW research in tropical environments, contributing directly to global carbon dioxide removal efforts.
  • Strengthen and refine our experimental design, ensuring the accuracy, reliability, and scalability of our measurements.
  • Elevate the scientific quality of our field and laboratory work, influencing key decisions across the organization.
  • Support the development of innovative MRV approaches that shape the future of climate‑tech science.
  • Build meaningful partnerships with researchers, institutions, and collaborators who help accelerate our mission.

Core working relationships

  • MRV Manager & Soil Scientist – direct reporting line, close collaboration on scientific strategy and priorities.
  • MRV Researchers – daily collaboration on experimental design, data analysis, fieldwork, and knowledge sharing.
  • Field & Operations Teams – coordination for sampling, experiment setup, monitoring, and logistics.
  • Sample Inventory and Lab Teams – coordination of sample processing and analysis, effective prioritisation.
  • Data & Analytics Teams – support on data interpretation, modeling, and integration into MRV systems.
  • External Partners – engagement with universities, labs, farmers, and research collaborators to advance ERW knowledge.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversight and management of the onsite experiments in ESALQ (e.g. greenhouse experiments)
  • Oversee the scientific operations, such as design of experiments
  • Generate, analyse and manage data and samples related to our experiments
  • Ensure quality control checks are carried out on data generated and sample collection
  • Oversee sample inventory management and processing
  • Provide support and research to help the science team strategy moving forward
  • Compare, present and discuss data and research (e.g. recent papers) internally with our science team as well as with leading researchers globally
  • Available to deputise or cover for other members of the science team when they are away on leave or unable to carry out tasks
  • Available to support on field work and infield tasks
  • May lead on certain novel R&D topics related to EW

You can be a Rock‑Star if you have

  • A PhD or at least a master’s degree in Soil Science, Agronomy, Earth Science, Geochemistry, Biogeochemistry, or a related field.
  • Solid knowledge of geology and weathering processes in tropical soils.
  • Fluency in Portuguese.
  • Advanced English, sufficient to present and discuss research within an international team.
  • Residency in or near Piracicaba (SP), or willingness to relocate.
  • Experience ensuring data quality and working with large sets of samples.
  • A deep curiosity for the science behind ERW in tropical agricultural systems, and the ability to dive into details with rigor.
  • An independent, confident, hands‑on approach—proactive, energetic, and driven to make things happen.
  • A fast‑learning mindset, with the motivation to continuously develop both professionally and personally.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to break down complex scientific problems and communicate them clearly and concisely.
  • A collaborative spirit—you enjoy working with others, supporting the team, and actively stepping in when needed.
  • Scientific rigor and high attention to detail.
  • Adaptability and resilience in rapidly evolving field and lab environments.
  • Strong ownership mindset, with the ability to manage projects end‑to‑end.
  • Clear communication and strong alignment with our mission.

Key qualities

  • Scientific rigor and high attention to detail.
  • Adaptability and resilience in rapidly evolving field and lab environments.
  • Strong ownership mindset, with the ability to manage projects end‑to‑end.
  • Clear communication and strong alignment with our mission.

Bonus points (not required)

  • Experience with greenhouse experiments, lysimeters, or soil analyses.
  • Knowledge of carbon removal methodologies or MRV frameworks.
  • Prior experience in tropical agriculture or working with field‑based experiments.
  • Familiarity with analytical equipment, geochemical modeling, or hydrology.

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust: You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes.
  • Drive: You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands‑on, can‑do attitude, propelled by urgency.
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change.

Benefits

  • Compensation expectations and our comp philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly.
  • Home Office Budget.
  • Personal development budget.
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance.
  • 40 days annual leave.
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference and belong to a vision.
  • Occasional off‑sites in Brazil yay!
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity.

InPlanet Compensation Philosophy

At InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate. The reason behind our salary range being wide or undefined at the first stages of the interview is because of our international presence and globally distributed workforce, we utilize geo ranges to account for varying pay differentials, forming a crucial part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive across diverse markets as we expand our reach. These ranges are determined by role, level, and location, recognizing the nuanced demands of each market. Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II.

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Main responsibilities

Executar as atividades de limpeza em geral nas dependências internas e externas do Hospital. Recolher lixo, abastecer material de limpeza e higiene. Manter o material arrumado.

Ensino Fundamental completo.

Experiência mínima de 06 meses na área de higiene e limpeza.

title: Professor de Ensino Fundamental I - Bilingue
description:
A Associação Santa Marcelina dedica-se à construção de uma Rede de Educação formada por faculdades, escolas e obras sociais. Presente em 9 Estados, atendendo da Educação Infantil à Educação Superior, a instituição é reconhecida por seu empenho em transformar a sociedade, tendo a ciência como instrumento e os valores cristãos como essência.

Responsabilidades

  • Ministrar aulas para alunos do Ensino Fundamental I, a partir do planejamento anual, com os planos de curso por disciplina e considerando o Plano de Aula Semanal ou quinzenal, com o uso de atividades pedagógicas orais e escritas, mediação e orientação, proporcionando a aprendizagem.
  • Elaborar planos de cursos por disciplinas e por trimestre, utilizando o material didático como apoio para organização dos conteúdos que serão ministrados ao longo do ano, estruturando o Planejamento Anual.
  • Elaborar Plano de Aula para a semana ou quinzena, utilizando diferentes fontes de pesquisa, leitura do material didático e cronograma adotado para seleção dos conteúdos a serem ministrado, constando questionamentos, estratégias, atividades e formas de avaliação, para levar o aluno à aprendizagem significativa.
  • Elaborar relatórios de acompanhamento dos alunos, a partir das observações ao longo de um período, registrando e descrevendo os pontos fortes e fracos de seu desenvolvimento, para acompanhar e registrar os processos e dificuldades dos mesmos e comunicar a família as características do processo de aprendizagem apresentado, bem como, replanejar a prática pedagógica de modo a auxiliar diante das dificuldades.
  • Realizar reuniões com pais, lendo texto reflexivo para discussão, apresentando dados qualitativos do trimestre e efetuando a leitura da pauta com avisos gerais, entregando boletins e abrindo espaço para que os pais possam ser atendidos de forma individual para tratar de questões mais delicadas e/ou que demandem ações mais específicas.
  • Prestar atendimento individual aos pais durante as aulas especializadas, agendando antecipadamente a reunião e informando sobre o desempenho do aluno, relatando as dificuldades na aprendizagem, no comportamento ou qualquer apontamento que julgar oportuno comunicar.
  • Corrigir, conceitual e ortograficamente, todas as atividades escritas dos alunos, verificando livros, cadernos ou folhas, para verificação do domínio da forma culta da escrita e dos aspectos conceituais.
  • Acompanhar os alunos na locomoção pelo Colégio nas trocas de aulas e ida e volta do recreio, assegurando que os alunos da turma não se desviem do caminho determinado e se desloquem com respeito e disciplina.
  • Consultar as agendas escolares dos alunos diariamente, corrigindo erros ortográficos e verificando se há recados dos pais, para garantir que o aluno copiou corretamente o que deve ser feito como lição de casa.
  • Participar da reunião pedagógica com os demais professores, discutindo os assuntos de acordo com a pauta da semana, refletindo sobre o trabalho da série.
  • Participar de palestras para atualização dos conhecimentos.
  • Selecionar as atividades que serão divulgadas no site, escolhendo uma por divulgação, tirando foto e elaborando o texto a ser vinculado, repassando para a Coordenação providenciar a publicação.
  • Acompanhar os alunos no estudo do meio, no horário estipulado pelo Colégio, auxiliando na construção da aprendizagem fora da sala de aula.
  • Estudar o Referencial curricular e participar da discussão em grupo para a partilha do que foi absorvido com o estudo.
  • Analisar e escolher livros didáticos e paradidáticos a serem adotados pelo Colégio, a partir da seleção da Coordenação de algumas coleções de livros, opinando sobre quais livros estão de acordo com as necessidades dos alunos e proposta de trabalho da Instituição.

Qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Pedagogia.
  • Fluência em inglês.
  • Cursos complementares na área de atuação serão diferenciais.
  • Local de trabalho: Alto da Boa Vista.

Benefícios

  • Universidade Corporativa e Pronto Atendimento via Telemedicina.

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going

Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries.

Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security.

With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity.

If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you!

What You’ll Do:

  • Consistently achieve quarterly and annual sales quotas through a solid, measurable sales process while conducting detailed and professional sales campaigns;
  • Build a pipeline of new clients through heavy prospecting and networking within the Corporate & FSP sectors;
  • Build and maintain effective client relationships, and strategically navigate to identify and close up & cross-sell expansion business;
  • Develop deep insights regarding customer use cases, internal decision-making nuances, budget cycles, and other key information;
  • Understand the competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position the value of Magnet Forensics’ portfolio of solutions;
  • Solution Selling by prescribing positive business outcome(s) to the customer’s current business problem(s);
  • Facilitate technical product demonstrations alongside a team of supporting Solution Consultants and manage product trial lifecycle;
  • Expand new and mature existing channel partner relationships to extend reach and accelerate new business growth;
  • Accurately forecast the state of the region weekly, fully leverage Magnet’s complete Sales tech stack, and maintain complete and accurate records of all sales activities in Magnet’s systems.

*Note: Travel is a part of this role and could be expected up to 30% of the time.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience selling software in a fast-paced, competitive market;
  • A track record of consistent quota achievement and ability to deliver consistently against targets – in both direct and channel capacities ;
  • The ability to expand the scope of an opportunity at a strategic and tactical level, and utilize appropriate resources to execute successfully;
  • Great understanding of a complex sales process, buying process, and business drivers for enterprise clients;
  • Technical aptitude and ability to learn new business and technical concepts quickly.

*Fluency in Portuguese, Spanish, and English

Nice to Have Skills

  • Sales background in DFIR (Digital Forensics) and/or Cybersecurity arena;

What We Are Looking For

We’re looking for someone who checks off most, but not all, of the boxes listed in “skills and experiences”. It’s more important to us to find candidates who can display indicators of success through skills they have developed and experiences they have been a part of, than to find folks who have ‘been there, done that”. We want to be part of your development journey, and we’ll learn as much from you as you learn from us.

How We Work

At Magnet Forensics, we take a hybrid-flexible approach to support your productivity and work-life balance. If you’re within a comfortable travel distance to one of our offices, you’ll occasionally join us in person. How often you’ll come in depends on your department and team needs, typically ranging from weekly to monthly. These in-person moments help us build stronger connections, spark new ideas, and celebrate our successes together. Most days, you can choose what works best for you, while staying in tune with your team’s goals.

We’re excited to welcome you to our team and look forward to achieving great things together - both in the office and wherever you work best!

The Most Important Thing

We’re looking for candidates that can provide examples of how they have demonstrated Magnet CODE in their previous experiences:

CARE – We care about each other and our mission to make a difference in the world.

OWN – We are accountable for our results – while never forgetting to act with integrity, empathy, and respect.

DEDICATE – We put our heart and soul into meeting the needs of our customers and helping them serve the people they protect.

EVOLVE – We are constantly innovating and exploring new ways to work together to make an impact with our work.

Here at Magnet Forensics, we are committed to continuous learning and are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. This commitment will be reflected in our hiring processes and embedded in our values and how we treat one another. If you’re interested in this role, but do not meet all of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply anyways.

Magnet Forensics is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. We are committed to providing an inclusive, accessible recruitment process and work environment. Accommodation is available to all applicants upon request throughout the hiring process. Please contact should you require any accommodations.

All offers of employment at Magnet are contingent upon satisfactory completion of a background check. All background checks will be conducted in accordance with all applicable laws. Magnet will consider each position’s job duties, among other factors, in determining what constitutes satisfactory completion of the background check. Refusal to consent to a background check may be grounds for revoking an offer of employment.

US Applicants: Magnet Forensics participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

title: AIDS 2026 Prevention Ambassador Fellowship in Brazil (Fully Funded)
description:
Applications are open for the AIDS 2026 Prevention Ambassador Fellowship, a fully supported international opportunity. The AIDS 2026 Prevention Ambassador Fellowship supports individuals working to expand knowledge of and access to HIV prevention by strengthening their reach, networks, and engagement with the latest scientific research and policy developments. Fellows will take part in AIDS 2026, the 26th International AIDS Conference, held in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil (25–30 July 2026), which brings together global experts, community leaders, and people living with HIV, both in person and virtually.

Selected fellows will receive support to develop and deliver impactful digital HIV prevention content before and during the conference as part of the IAS “Rethink. Rebuild. Rise.” campaign. This includes funding for content projects, full support to attend the conference in person, and opportunities to connect with researchers, policymakers, activists, and peers while participating in targeted networking and professional development activities.

The fellowship begins after a competitive selection process, with notifications issued in March 2026, and concludes on 14 August 2026.

Key Details and Dates

  • Application Deadline: 15 February 2026 (23:00 CET)
  • Result Announcement: March 2026
  • Conference Dates: 25–30 July 2026
  • Fellowship End Date: 14 August 2026
  • Funding Type: Fully funded
  • Organizer: International AIDS Society (IAS)
  • Eligible Countries: All countries
  • Eligible Gender: Male/Female
  • Target Group: HIV prevention advocates, digital content creators, public health professionals, community leaders
  • Focus Areas: HIV prevention and advocacy
  • Program Language: English
  • Host Country: Brazil

Benefits

Selected fellows will receive:

  • Full support to attend AIDS 2026 in person, including:
    • International travel
    • Accommodation
    • Per diem
    • Ground transportation
    • Visa costs (if applicable)
  • Up to USD 1,000 total for digital HIV prevention content creation:
    • Up to USD 500 for pre-conference content
    • Up to USD 500 for content produced during AIDS 2026
  • Access to global HIV researchers, policymakers, activists, and community leaders
  • Professional development, networking, and visibility through the IAS “Rethink. Rebuild. Rise.” campaign

Eligibility Criteria

Applicants must:

  • Have a proven track record in HIV prevention advocacy or communication
  • Demonstrate digital content creation experience with a minimum of 5,000 total followers/subscribers across platforms (or documented alternative reach)
  • Use ethical, evidence-based, non-stigmatizing, rights-based language
  • Be 18 years or older at the time of application
  • Be proficient in English (multilingual applicants encouraged)
  • Commit to pre-event onboarding and full participation during AIDS 2026

Priority is given to applicants who:

  • Work with or represent key and priority populations
  • Are based in low- and middle-income countries
  • Produce content for underserved audiences
  • Collaborate with community-led organizations or clinics

Required Documents

Applicants must submit the following as part of the online application:

  • Completed application form
  • Demographic information
  • Work history
  • Statement of motivation
  • Descriptions of two digital HIV prevention communication projects:
    • One project before AIDS 2026
    • One project during AIDS 2026
    • Including objectives, themes, target audiences, platforms, and two sample posts
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) with:
    • Portfolio and/or links to recent HIV prevention content (past 6–12 months)
    • Evidence of reach (e.g., screenshots of analytics or engagement metrics)
  • Letter of support from employer (if employed)
  • Letter of reference (if self-employed)

How to Apply?

  • Download and complete the official application form
  • Prepare all required documents and project descriptions
  • Submit your application before 15 February 2026 (23:00 CET)

Submission Email:

For questions, email or visit the official website of the International AIDS Society.

title: Manager, Volunteer Operations
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department

Workforce, People & Culture

Location

Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer Operations Manager will help bring together and manage thousands of volunteers across the 8 Host Cities.

In this role, you will support the planning and delivery of the Volunteer Programme, especially in the important areas of attracting, recruiting, training, and supporting volunteers during the Tournament. You will work closely with many internal teams and with the Host Cities of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. The role will work closely with FIFA Zurich to ensure consistency and accountability.

Your main responsibilities will include managing key projects from start to finish. This includes organising volunteer recruitment activities, operational organisation of volunteer trainings, and overseeing the design and set-up of Volunteer Centres in each Host City. You will also create clear operational plans to ensure we meet programme milestones and deliver a consistent, high-quality volunteer experience in all 8 Host Cities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, coordinate, and support the daily operations of the Volunteer Programme while helping deliver several connected projects – including setting up volunteer services such as transport, catering, rewards and recognition.
  • Work on important parts of the volunteer journey, such as promotional events, recruitment, training, and Tournament-time operations. These projects will develop and change as we get closer to FWWC27.
  • Contribute to headcount planning efforts working closely with all Functional Areas to collect, confirm and combine volunteer requirements.
  • Support Host Cities with planning and running the Volunteer Recruitment Centres, helping us deliver a unified Volunteer Programme across Brazil.
  • Create clear, central plans and processes that help teams work efficiently and ensure volunteers have consistent experience everywhere.
  • Build strong working relationships with Functional Areas, Host City teams, stadium authorities, and service providers to ensure smooth project delivery.
  • Participation in venue operation planning and assisting in the central coordination of volunteer data capture and management. FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ Job Description.
  • Help develop volunteer policies and procedures that follow FIFA standards and guidelines.
  • Plan and run readiness workshops for the FWWC27 Volunteer Management team to ensure all locations are prepared for operations.
  • Manage procurement processes (including RFI and RFP) for all services needed for volunteer operations from launch through Tournament time, in coordination with FIFA Zurich.
  • Work with Functional Areas to ensure all volunteer-related items are correctly counted, prepared, and delivered at each stage of the volunteer journey. Support Host Cities in delivering their responsibilities on time and in line with the central plans.

Your Profile

  • Education: Master in Sports Management or Event Management or Project Management preferred.
  • Experience: 5 years + Proven experience in leading and managing large-scale volunteer programmes including fit for purpose attraction, recruitment, engagement and tournament time operational tactics.
  • Strong understanding of effective volunteer management best practices.
  • Solid knowledge of project management principles and methodologies, with the ability to plan, coordinate, and deliver multiple workstreams simultaneously.
  • High level of proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Experience working with a Volunteer Management System (e.g. Rosterfy) or similar platforms is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop beneficial working relationships with internal and external stakeholder.
  • Strong organisational and time-management skills, with a proven ability to prioritise tasks, multitask effectively, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience operating in complex, multi-stakeholder environments, with the flexibility and resilience to adapt to change and manage competing priorities.
  • Excellent communication skills in both English and Portuguese (written and verbal), with the ability to communicate clearly across diverse teams and cultures.
  • Creative, with aptitude to adapt, anticipate risks and remain solution orientated.
  • A collaborative and inclusive team player, capable of working effectively with colleagues both on-site and remotely, while fostering a positive and respectful working environment.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Neste papel você será nosso(a) Professor(a) de Creative Tech. Procuramos alguém com paixão e curiosidade pelo universo de tecnologia e de educação, que tenha experiência com planejamento e execução de aulas para crianças e jovens.

RESPONSABILIDADES

O que você fará:

  • Adquirir conhecimento sobre os programas curriculares utilizados nas séries em que leciona;
  • Trabalhar colaborativamente com outros professores e lideranças da matéria e do segmento, buscando alinhamento e consistência;
  • Planejar as aulas e produzir materiais pedagógicos, levando em conta as individualidades dos alunos;
  • Ministrar aulas de Creative Tech alinhadas com a BNCC e o Material Didático selecionado pela escola (físico ou digital);
  • Utilizar práticas variadas de ensino/aprendizagem, incluindo metodologias ativas, ensino responsivo, avaliação para o aprendizado (Assessment for Learning) e métodos investigativos;
  • Utilizar de forma consistente tecnologias para enriquecer e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Supervisionar alunos em espaços escolares;
  • Substituir professores no mesmo segmento quando solicitado;
  • Mediar relacionamento entre crianças, famílias e escola;
  • Preparar avaliações e comunicar os resultados;
  • Tabular e analisar dados pedagógicos com o intuito de ajustar ensino e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Formatar e alimentar com dados nossa plataforma de acompanhamento de avaliações (iSams) em preparação para relatórios para famílias;
  • Participar de reuniões pedagógicas (incluindo COC) e eventos realizados na escola;
  • Garantir a segurança física e emocional dos alunos, e zelar pelo seu crescimento sócio-emocional (safeguarding).

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

REQUISITOS

  • Diploma de licenciatura em Pedagogia, Design, Artes ou áreas afins;
  • Inglês fluente;
  • Experiência com ensino.

Nossos professores devem ser capazes de/devem ter:

  • Capacidade de trabalhar colaborativamente, em equipe;
  • Paixão pela profissão;
  • Adaptar seu estilo de ensino incorporando feedbacks;
  • Estar sempre em busca de melhorias;
  • Atitude positiva frente a mudanças;
  • Compreensão profunda da matéria lecionada;
  • Estabelecer expectativas claras e esticar metas;
  • Excelente planejamento de aulas e domínio de sala;
  • Habilidade de julgar a efetividade do aprendizado;
  • Comprometimento com o desenvolvimento dos alunos, avaliando os resultados e fornecendo feedback para melhorar seu desempenho;
  • Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais;
  • Espírito colaborativo - desejo de trabalhar como parte de um time;
  • Pós-graduação em andamento ou concluída.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

description:
Professor(a) de História (History) - Fundamental 2 - Barra da Tijuca/RJ

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

SOBRE A VAGA

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Procuramos um(a) Professor(a) de História (History) - Fundamental 2. Deve ser uma pessoa com paixão por educação e pelo universo dinâmico da escola, que tenha experiência em escola regular ou bilíngue com planejamento e execução de aulas dessa disciplina.

RESPONSABILIDADES

O que você fará:

  • Adquirir conhecimento sobre os programas curriculares utilizados nas séries em que leciona;
  • Trabalhar colaborativamente com outros professores e lideranças da matéria e do segmento, buscando alinhamento e consistência;
  • Planejar as aulas e produzir materiais pedagógicos, levando em conta as individualidades dos alunos;
  • Ministrar aulas de História (History) alinhadas com a BNCC e o Material Didático selecionado pela escola (físico ou digital);
  • Utilizar práticas variadas de ensino/aprendizagem, incluindo metodologias ativas, ensino responsivo, avaliação para o aprendizado (Assessment for Learning) e métodos investigativos;
  • Utilizar de forma consistente tecnologias para enriquecer e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Supervisionar alunos em espaços escolares;
  • Substituir professores no mesmo segmento quando solicitado;
  • Mediar relacionamento entre crianças, famílias e escola;
  • Preparar avaliações e comunicar os resultados;
  • Tabular e analisar dados pedagógicos com o intuito de ajustar ensino e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Formatar e alimentar com dados nossa plataforma de acompanhamento de avaliações (iSams) em preparação para relatórios para famílias;
  • Participar de reuniões pedagógicas (incluindo COC) e eventos realizados na escola;
  • Garantir a segurança física e emocional dos alunos, e zelar pelo seu crescimento sócio-emocional (safeguarding).

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

REQUISITOS

O que você precisa ter:

  • Diploma de Licenciatura em História;
  • Experiência com Fundamental 2;
  • Inglês fluente para ministrar aulas nesse idioma.

Nossos professores devem ser capazes de/devem ter:

  • Capacidade de trabalhar colaborativamente, em equipe;
  • Paixão pela profissão;
  • Adaptar seu estilo de ensino incorporando feedbacks;
  • Estar sempre em busca de melhorias;
  • Atitude positiva frente a mudanças;
  • Compreensão profunda da matéria lecionada;
  • Estabelecer expectativas claras e esticar metas;
  • Excelente planejamento de aulas e domínio de sala;
  • Habilidade de julgar a efetividade do aprendizado;
  • Comprometimento com o desenvolvimento dos alunos, avaliando os resultados e fornecendo feedback para melhorar seu desempenho;
  • Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais;
  • Espírito colaborativo - desejo de trabalhar como parte de um time;
