title: Engineer II, Senior Technology- Marine/ Mechanical/ Environmental
description:
Job Description

Are you passionate about being at the forefront of emerging technologies in the maritime and offshore industries?

ABS is a leading Classification Society driven by its mission to promote the security of life and property and preserve the natural environment. In fulfilling this mission, ABS leads research and develops guidance and requirements focused on the safety of implementing new technology in the marine and offshore environment.

As a Marine/ Mechanical / Environmental Engineer, you will be actively engaged in driving industry‑leading research and development associated with machinery and systems for marine and offshore applications.

What You Will Do:

  • Lead research and assess the maturity of new technologies in the marine industry related to carbon capture, CO2 transportation, non-carbon/ low carbon‑based fuels, renewable energies including different machinery and systems etc.).
  • Establish guidance and classification requirements for the marine and offshore industry on the application of new technology.
  • Support ABS technical community on queries regarding different onboard mechanical equipment and systems.
  • Maintain and demonstrate thought leadership through technical publications and presentations.
  • Participate in industry societies to develop and enhance technical capabilities.
  • Remain knowledgeable of new scientific methods and developments affecting the technical scope of assigned responsibilities and recommend changes in engineering processes and programs as warranted by such developments.
  • Devises new approaches to problems encountered and recommend changes in methods, procedures, or design where necessary.
  • Monitor the technical quality, content, consistency, continuity, and timeliness of action of all assigned projects.
  • Maintain liaison with other engineering specialists, internally and externally.
  • Assist Principal Engineer and/or immediate superior in developing qualification statements, proposals, bids, and other presentation materials.
  • Promote ABS Quality System within an assigned group of engineers.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Minimum of five (5) years relevant engineering experience in the energy industry, shipyard, design/consulting company, shipping/oil company, university, or classification society.
  • Minimum of a bachelor’s degree in mechanical/marine/environmental engineering or other related discipline; M.S. is preferred.
  • Having experience or knowledge with AI as it relates to mechanical/maritime concepts is a plus.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Knowledge of onboard machinery and systems is a plus, including emerging technologies such as carbon capture (both pre‑ and post‑combustion), CO2 transportation, ammonia crackers, methane reformers, methane slip, renewable energies, electrolyzers, and energy‑saving devices. Also basic understanding of marine piping systems (e.g., fresh water, sea water, lubrication oil, fuel oil, compressed air, hydraulic system, cryogenics piping, etc.).
  • Knowledge of general mechanical systems.
  • General knowledge of environmental engineering.
  • Awareness of alternative marine fuels, such as hydrogen, ammonia, methanol, synthetic fuel, and biofuel, etc.
  • Awareness of fuel cell technology and application.
  • Awareness of emerging technologies and trends in the marine industry, including emerging engines, fuels, power generation, and energy savings.
  • Strong communicator with excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Excellent command of the English language.
  • Demonstrated ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to learn the ABS Health, Safety, Quality & Environmental Management System.

Reporting Relationships

This position reports to a Senior or Manager level position or above.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We’re at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting‑edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever‑present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Equal Opportunity

  • Ministrar aulas de Português (Produção Textual) alinhadas com a BNCC e o Material Didático selecionado pela escola (físico ou digital);
  • Utilizar práticas variadas de ensino/aprendizagem, incluindo metodologias ativas, ensino responsivo, avaliação para o aprendizado (Assessment for Learning) e métodos investigativos;
  • Utilizar de forma consistente tecnologias para enriquecer e melhorar o aprendizado;

  • Tabular e analisar dados pedagógicos com o intuito de ajustar ensino e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Formatar e alimentar com dados nossa plataforma de acompanhamento de avaliações (iSams) em preparação para relatórios para famílias;
  • Participar de reuniões pedagógicas (incluindo COC) e eventos realizados na escola;
  • Garantir a segurança física e emocional dos alunos, e zelar pelo seu crescimento socioemocional (safeguarding).

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Atitude positiva frente a mudanças;
  • Compreensão profunda da matéria lecionada;
  • Estabelecer expectativas claras e esticar metas;

  • Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais;

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. title: MRV Researcher
description:
About InPlanet

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. The company is scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics.

Our vision is simple but bold: to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders – and we’re growing fast.

Our culture blends people-first care and performance excellence . The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact.

We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil, where the real climate impact happens.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversight and management of the onsite experiments in ESALQ (e.g. greenhouse experiments)
  • You oversee the scientific operations, such as design of experiments
  • You generate, analyse and manage data and samples related to our experiments
  • You ensure quality control checks are carried out on data generated and sample collection
  • You oversee sample inventory management and processing
  • You provide support and research to help the science team strategy moving forward
  • You compare, present and discuss data and research (e.g. recent papers) internally with our (science) team as well as with leading researchers globally
  • You are available to deputise or cover for other members of the science team when they are away on leave or unable to carry out tasks
  • You are available to support on field work and infield tasks
  • You may lead on certain novel R+D topics related to EW

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust : You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes
  • Drive : You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands‑on, can‑do attitude, propelled by urgency
  • Impact : You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change

You can be a Rock‑Star if you have

  • A PhD or at least a master’s degree in Soil Science, Agronomy, Earth Science, Geochemistry, Biogeochemistry, or a related field.
  • Solid knowledge of geology and weathering processes in tropical soils.
  • Fluency in Portuguese.
  • Advanced English, sufficient to present and discuss research within an international team.
  • Residency in or near Piracicaba (SP), or willingness to relocate.
  • Experience ensuring data quality and working with large sets of samples
  • A deep curiosity for the science behind ERW in tropical agricultural systems, and the ability to dive into details with rigor.
  • An independent, confident, hands‑on approach—proactive, energetic, and driven to make things happen.
  • A fast‑learning mindset, with the motivation to continuously develop both professionally and personally.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to break down complex scientific problems and communicate them clearly and concisely.
  • A collaborative spirit—you enjoy working with others, supporting the team, and actively stepping in when needed.

Key qualities

  • Scientific rigor and high attention to detail.
  • Adaptability and resilience in rapidly evolving field and lab environments.
  • Strong ownership mindset, with the ability to manage projects end‑to‑end.
  • Clear communication and strong alignment with our mission.

Bonus points (not required)

  • Experience with greenhouse experiments, lysimeters, or soil analyses.
  • Knowledge of carbon removal methodologies or MRV frameworks.
  • Prior experience in tropical agriculture or working with field‑based experiments.
  • Familiarity with analytical equipment, geochemical modeling, or hydrology.

Benefits

  • Compensation expectations and our comp philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly.
  • Home Office Budget
  • Personal development budget
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance
  • 40 days annual leave
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference and belong to a vision.
  • Occasional off‑sites in Brazil yay!
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity

About the Role

Language skills: advanced English + Portuguese

As our MRV Researcher , you will lead research on Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical soils, with a particular focus on soil analyses. You will design, execute, and manage experiments that accurately monitor carbon dioxide removal, ensuring scientific rigor and high‑quality data. You will take full ownership of our on‑site experiments, drive improvements, and help shape our scientific strategy for ERW.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with the entire science team, supporting and contributing to all experiments and in‑field monitoring activities. You will also engage with internal and external stakeholders, strengthening relationships that advance our research goals.

You will report directly to our MRV Manager & Soil Scientist, Mariane , and work alongside a multidisciplinary group of dedicated and ambitious MRV researchers. Your week may take you between the lab, the field, our on‑site experiments, the greenhouse, visits to ESALQ and ESALQTEC, or focused work from home—always within a collaborative and high‑trust environment.

The impact you can make

  • Advance cutting‑edge ERW research in tropical environments, contributing directly to global carbon dioxide removal efforts.
  • Strengthen and refine our experimental design, ensuring the accuracy, reliability, and scalability of our measurements.
  • Elevate the scientific quality of our field and laboratory work, influencing key decisions across the organization.
  • Support the development of innovative MRV approaches that shape the future of climate‑tech science.
  • Build meaningful partnerships with researchers, institutions, and collaborators who help accelerate our mission.

Core working relationships

  • MRV Manager & Soil Scientist – direct reporting line, close collaboration on scientific strategy and priorities.
  • MRV Researchers – daily collaboration on experimental design, data analysis, fieldwork, and knowledge sharing.
  • Field & Operations Teams – coordination for sampling, experiment setup, monitoring, and logistics.
  • Sample Inventory and Lab Teams – coordination of sample processing and analysis, effective prioritisation.
  • Data & Analytics Teams – support on data interpretation, modeling, and integration into MRV systems.
  • External Partners – engagement with universities, labs, farmers, and research collaborators to advance ERW knowledge.

InPlanet Compensation Philosophy

At InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate.

The reason behind our salary range being wide or undefined at the first stages of the interview is because of our international presence and globally distributed workforce, we utilize geo ranges to account for varying pay differentials, forming a crucial part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive across diverse markets as we expand our reach.

These ranges are determined by role, level, and location, recognizing the nuanced demands of each market. The actual base pay for the selected candidate is influenced by factors such as location, skills, experience, training, business requirements, and market dynamics, with the range subject to potential adjustments in alignment with our commitment to fairness and transparency.

Application Process

Roughly 6 hours across 3-6 weeks from CV‑screening.

  • Interview with Talent & People Partner or Head of People (values & motivation)
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (required core skills and competencies)
  • (optional third interview)
  • Challenge with 3+ team members (specific task, preparation needed)
  • Verbal reference check & psychometric profiling
  • Offer

To hear about updates on future opportunities, please follow us on LinkedIn. To keep up with InPlanet market updates, subscribe to our Newsletter.

How to Apply

  • We kindly ask you to submit your CV in English, as this is the main language we use here at InPlanetunless it is justified to be in Portuguese). This job description is intended to provide a clear summary of the responsibilities, scope, and expectations associated with this opportunity. It may apply to a range of working relationships, including full‑time or part‑time employment as well as independent contractor or service‑based arrangements, depending on the candidate's location and compliance framework. Each engagement is carefully assessed on a case‑by‑case basis to ensure alignment with applicable laws and InPlanet’s global operating standards.

Being an equal opportunities work provider is very important to us, and we are committed to ensuring that no applicant receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions which cannot be shown to be justifiable. We design our processes to be fair and equitable, and we believe in continuous learning.

title: Computational Scientist
description:
Job Duties

We seek a talented Computational Scientist with an M.Sc. in Computational Science or Engineering and academic and/or professional experience. A Ph.D. degree with a strong background in Computational Science is a plus. The ideal candidate for this position is an expert in porting complex scientific programming codes to parallel hybrid (CPU+GPU) clusters. You must have a passion for optimizing and improving code speed-up. Excellent problem-solving ability and good oral and written communication skills in both English and Portuguese are required.

Qualifications

  • Expert knowledge of modern C++ (e.g., C++11, C++14, C++17).
  • Expert knowledge of GPGPU frameworks/software layers such as CUDA and OpenCL.
  • Expert knowledge of distributed and parallel computing in hybrid (CPU and GPU) clusters.
  • Good knowledge of device-level optimization and GPU architecture.
  • Good knowledge of modern C++ design patterns and software engineering concepts (e.g., template metaprogramming, generic programming, etc.).
  • Ability to work in both Windows and Linux environments.
  • Some experience with programming/scripting languages such as Python and Matlab.
  • Some experience with MPI programming.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Proven experience porting legacy serial or MPI/OpenMP code to GPUs.
  • Knowledge of scientific computing (e.g., linear and nonlinear solvers, numerical methods, etc.).
  • Familiarity with computational mathematics (e.g., linear algebra, calculus, matrix decompositions, etc.).
  • Knowledge of PDE discretization methods, such as Finite Element, Finite Volume, or Lattice Boltzmann.
  • Familiarity with open-source scientific computing libraries (e.g., HYPRE, BOOST++, PETSC, DUNE, LAPACK, etc.).
  • Familiarity with CMake, Makefiles, and other tools for multi-platform code compilation.
  • Knowledge of fluid flow physics.

Overview

Collective Hospitality is seeking enthusiastic Manager of Acquisitions & Hotel Development (Hospitality Experience) to join our Hotel Development Team where you’ll join a team of professionals who love what they do. In this role, you will engage and collaborate closely with a broad range of external parties including: Hotel Owners, Hotel Developers, Hotel Operators, Consultants, Lenders, Builders, and Real estate agents. You will work with our internal team leaders of architects/designers, brand, and Project Services, Operations, Legal, and Finance colleagues. You will be part of a team passionate to build the world most existing Gen Z hotel brands.

Who We Are

At Collective Hospitality, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues. As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our Culture of Care and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Well-being. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and seek various opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

Development and its new-unit growth is one of the principal drivers of Collective Hospitality’s growth and earnings. The Business Development Manager’s primary contact with the external real estate community. His/her is responsible for the future development and growth of our hotel brands including Socialtel, Slumber Party Hostels, Bodega Hostels, Path Resorts (coming soon), and Castaway Island (coming soon). This position requires an understanding of the hotel development process, knowledge of hotel markets, and an ability to develop relationships and convince hotel owners and developers that Collective Hospitality products are well-suited for the location and market. The Business Development Manager is the primary lead for the management group through the application, approval negotiation, and execution of the management agreements, lease contracts, hotel acquisitions, and other arrangements.

A bulleted list of key aspects of the role

  • Understanding of the local real estate and hotel markets
  • Analysis and evaluation of hotel project feasibility to determine the potential growth opportunities for Collective Hospitality brands including new build and conversion opportunities
  • Desire to travel extensively (75%) and engage with new and existing owners
  • Represent Collective Hospitality at key industry events, conferences, and tradeshows

Qualifications

Experience Required:

  • 5+ years of real estate experience, hotel feasibility, hotel financial analysis, and be well connected in your region.
  • Established relationships with owners, operators, consultants, management companies, lenders, builders, etc.
  • Demonstrated success in meeting or exceeding goals/quotas and driving business results.
  • Strong negotiation and influencing skills.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and demeanor

  • Professional

  • Familiarity with the hotel markets in your local region
  • A working knowledge of hotel management and lease agreements would be a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across the organization and be the liaison between development and the franchise groups is critical.

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real‑world expertise from across the globe.

Who We're Looking For

We are seeking curious and intellectually proactive contributors who double‑check assumptions and play devil’s advocate, comfortable with ambiguity and complexity. This flexible, project‑based opportunity is ideal for analysts, researchers, experienced professionals and consultants with strong critical‑thinking skills, and for those open to a part‑time, non‑permanent role.

About the Project

You will create complex, realistic tasks that push frontier AI agents to their limits. Think scattered data, conditional procedures, and genuine domain expertise. You’ll build a detailed version with objective scoring, then write an ambiguous version to train the agent to succeed with less hand‑holding. Real expert complexity only – you’re improving the AI tools you’ll eventually use yourself.

If you have the relevant experience and are ready to take on this challenging and engaging project, join us!

How to Get Started

Apply to this post to contribute to projects aligned with your skills on your own schedule. To begin working in production, you’ll need to complete a qualification step and project onboarding, where you’ll become familiar with the guidelines interface and try your first real task with guidance from our quality team. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you’ll directly shape how useful these models become for your future work.

  • Proven ability to use English fluently in professional settings, written and verbal (C1/C2 level)
  • Access to a laptop, stable internet connection, and sufficient availability to engage with project tasks
  • Motivation to work with challenging, complex, but well‑defined guidelines, learn new methods, and strengthen domain‑specific skills

Benefits

Com experiência em gestão de negócios, desde 1955, a WLM atua no segmento automotivo e no agronegócio.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania , como caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, na prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos e produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com grande preocupação pela conservação do meio ambiente, as atividades produtivas são executadas visando as melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas e cuidados com as águas e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética.

Com essa aquisição, a WLM amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

A localização estratégica das unidades permite uma atuação com abrangente cobertura geográfica, garantindo presteza, qualidade e agilidade no atendimento.

A sua holding está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e possui uma filial corporativa em Minas Gerais, na Cidade de Contagem.

title: Analista de Audiovisual (RJ)
description:
LiveMode Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

O que nos move?

Claro, a paixão por esportes é indiscutível, mas também somos grandes amantes de inovação constante! Buscamos soluções digitais que conectem clubes, federações, ligas e marcas ao público de forma eficaz e inovadora. Nosso objetivo é construir um ecossistema que sustente o esporte nas próximas décadas, integrando o melhor do digital e da TV. É assim que estamos fazendo história e queremos encontrar mais pessoas que acreditem no potencial do que estamos construindo e queiram fazer parte disso.

Agora, imagina você começar a sua carreira trabalhando com esporte e numa empresa que vem transformando esse mercado?

Se isso te anima, estamos em busca de uma pessoa para atuar como Analista de Audiovisual , jogando junto com o nosso time de Conteúdo e Transmissões. Na LiveMode, cada movimento é uma jogada estratégica para liderança e inovação no mercado, e o audiovisual é o coração dessa engrenagem.

Nessa função, sua missão será editar, organizar e entregar conteúdos essenciais para as transmissões e programas da CazéTV , garantindo agilidade, precisão e criatividade na mesma intensidade com que o esporte acontece ao vivo.

Responsabilidades

  • Edição de VTs para transmissões, respeitando roteiros, compreendendo pedidos e equilibrando seu toque criativo com o briefing passado.
  • Edição em tempo real durante jogos, selecionando e cortando os melhores lances para os programas pós-jogo e demais conteúdos “quentes” da programação.
  • Participação em reuniões de pauta, trazendo ideias, referências e debates sobre temas relevantes para transmissões e conteúdos esportivos.
  • Acompanhamento de gravações internas e externas, apoiando a captação de materiais para transmissões e para o canal do YouTube.
  • Gestão rigorosa de arquivos, mantendo organização, padronização e facilidade de acesso para todo o time.
  • Interação direta com o time de Transmissões, entendendo demandas, priorizando o que é urgente e garantindo fluxo contínuo de entregas.

Requisitos necessários

  • Experiência com edição em Premiere, CapCut e/ou DaVinci. Capacidade de montagem, acabamento e finalização de vídeos.
  • Gestão e priorização de tarefas, com proatividade e autonomia para tomar decisões em cenários de alta demanda.
  • Organização e agilidade, trabalhando com prazos curtos e múltiplas entregas simultâneas.
  • Conhecimento de futebol, facilitando a leitura de jogo, entendimento dos lances relevantes e construção de narrativas esportivas.
  • Atenção às tendências e linguagem audiovisual, entendendo formatos, estilos e dinâmicas aplicáveis ao esporte e às transmissões.
  • Interesse em ferramentas de IA, buscando constantemente soluções que otimizem processos e acelerem workflows de edição e pós-produção.

Diferenciais desejáveis

  • Conhecimento básico de After Effects, Photoshop e/ou Illustrator.
  • Vivência com câmera DSLR, incluindo noções de iluminação, enquadramento e fotografia.
  • Experiência prévia com conteúdo esportivo, transmissões ao vivo ou produtoras do segmento.
  • Familiaridade com workflows de pós-produção em ambientes de alto volume.

Nossos benefícios

  • Auxílio Alimentação de R$ 1.250,00 por mês.
  • Vale Transporte (opcional) com desconto de 6% do salário bruto.
  • Plano de Saúde (Especial – SulAmérica) sem custo mensal, coparticipação de 10% em consultas e exames.
  • Plano Odontológico (Mais DOC) sem custo mensal, com possibilidade de migração e desconto em folha.
  • TotalPass e Wellhub (opcionais) para academias, esportes e aplicativos de saúde.
  • Auxílio-Creche para filhos de até 5 anos e 11 meses, reembolso de despesas.
  • Auxílio para Dependentes PCD com laudo médico.
  • Seguro de Vida (Prudential).
  • Assessoria SESC para atividades culturais, esportivas, de lazer, saúde e educação.
  • Open English para cursos de inglês ou espanhol.

Nossa cultura

Na LiveMode, nossa missão é Transformar e Crescer o Esporte , e nossos valores são o combustível que nos move no dia a dia. Acreditamos que crescer exige inconformismo, ambição e consistência. Nossa cultura nasce disso: de gente que não aceita o que está aí, que quer fazer mais, aprender mais e entregar mais — sempre com responsabilidade e visão de futuro. Quem está na LiveMode está aqui para marcar a história do esporte no Brasil e no Mundo.

SOMOS EMPREENDEDORES ontem, hoje e sempre. Escolhemos o gol e corremos atrás dele com tudo. Focamos em poucas prioridades e vamos até o fim, sem distrações. Tratamos cada recurso como se fosse nosso, decidindo rápido e com coragem. Comunicação? Direta, aberta e na velocidade do jogo.

SOMOS UM TIME DE ALTA PERFORMANCE não uma família ou uma confraria de amigos. Família a gente não escolhe, mas o time escolhe quem joga. E quando o jogo é grande, não dá pra carregar quem não tá entregando. Aqui, a gente decide pelo melhor pra empresa, não pra uma área ou pessoa. Toda entrega tem um dono claro, que vai até o fim. Processos ajudam, mas não mandam: quem resolve são as pessoas.

SOMOS AMBICIOSOS pensamos sempre grande. A gente já fez muita coisa grande. Mas quem está na LiveMode sabe que dá pra ir além. Porque quem é ambicioso de verdade vive com a sensação de que sempre dá pra melhorar, crescer, fazer mais impacto. Aqui, a ambição não é discurso. É prática. Presentes no Rio de Janeiro, somos a escola responsável pela missão de formar pessoas que busquem sempre evoluir e que sejam capazes de construir um futuro melhor para si e para os que estão ao seu redor. Ajudamos os alunos a desenvolverem responsabilidades tanto acadêmicas quanto com relação às suas escolhas. Buscamos auxiliá-los na procura por diferentes meios para alcançarem os resultados que desejam, com olhar crítico e com a construção de novos pensamentos e ideias.

Nossas escolas promovem um ambiente colaborativo que estimula e reforça o espírito de coletividade. Encorajamos a troca e o diálogo em nossa comunidade escolar.

Se você sonha em trabalhar transformando vidas e reescrevendo histórias, seu lugar é no Pensi.

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Procuramos alguém para ser nosso(a) Professor(a) Regente de Português do Fundamental 1. Deve ser uma pessoa com paixão por educação e pelo universo dinâmico da escola, que tenha experiência em escola regular ou bilíngue com planejamento e execução de aulas.

O que você fará:

  • Adquirir conhecimento sobre os programas curriculares utilizados nas séries em que leciona;
  • Trabalhar colaborativamente com outros professores e lideranças da matéria e do segmento, buscando alinhamento e consistência;
  • Planejar as aulas e produzir materiais pedagógicos, levando em conta as individualidades dos alunos;
  • Ministrar aulas como Professor(a) Regente de Português no Fundamental 1 alinhadas com a BNCC e o Material Didático selecionado pela escola (físico ou digital);
  • Utilizar práticas variadas de ensino/aprendizagem, incluindo metodologias ativas, ensino responsivo, avaliação para o aprendizado (Assessment for Learning) e métodos investigativos;
  • Utilizar de forma consistente tecnologias para enriquecer e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Supervisionar alunos em espaços escolares;
  • Substituir professores no mesmo segmento quando solicitado;
  • Mediar relacionamento entre crianças, famílias e escola;
  • Preparar avaliações e comunicar os resultados;
  • Tabular e analisar dados pedagógicos com o intuito de ajustar ensino e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Formatar e alimentar com dados nossa plataforma de acompanhamento de avaliações (iSams) em preparação para relatórios para famílias;
  • Participar de reuniões pedagógicas (incluindo COC) e eventos realizados na escola;
  • Garantir a segurança física e emocional dos alunos, e zelar pelo seu crescimento sócio-emocionalsafeguarding).

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Diploma de Licenciatura em Pedagogia;
  • Experiência com Fundamental 1.

Nossos professores devem ser capazes de/devem ter:

  • Capacidade de trabalhar colaborativamente, em equipe;
  • Paixão pela profissão;
  • Estar sempre em busca de melhorias;
  • Atitude positiva frente a mudanças;
  • Compreensão profunda da matéria lecionada;
  • Estabelecer expectativas claras e esticar metas;
  • Excelente planejamento de aulas e domínio de sala;
  • Habilidade de julgar a efetividade do aprendizado;
  • Comprometimento com o desenvolvimento dos alunos, avaliando os resultados e fornecendo feedback para melhorar seu desempenho;
  • Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais;
  • Espírito colaborativo - desejo de trabalhar como parte de um time;
  • Pós-graduação em andamento ou concluída.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

Nossas equipes de logística estão mudando a maneira como interagimos com clientes em todo o mundo todos os dias e resolvendo alguns dos maiores desafios logísticos enfrentados não apenas pela Amazon, mas também por toda a indústria.

As operações serão feitas 7 dias por semana, incluindo feriados; portanto, trabalhar em diferentes turnos será parte dessa função.

  • Analisar dados de várias fontes e identificar tendências relevantes para que, a partir deles, decisões rápidas e importantes ao negócio sejam tomadas;
  • Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos;
  • Servir de elo entre os stakeholders internos e externos tendo em vista os objetivos, limites, conformidade e privacidade das informações;

title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Enterprise Customer Success Manager at Canonical

Customer success is a new and strategic department at Canonical, with the objective of reducing risk and churn, facilitating the adoption of new products or services, and supporting expansion within existing accounts. Customer Success Managers (CSM) are responsible for developing trust with their assigned customers and providing them with the best possible experience navigating Canonical's vast offering. By clearly understanding their customers' objectives, the CSM can align expectations, suggest a large range of additional services or product capacity to increase loyalty, alleviate any pain points, and help draw and deliver on an appropriate collaboration roadmap.

We are growing our Customer Success team to continue to offer thoughtful, smart, precise interactions across our product portfolio, from Ubuntu to open-source infrastructure and applications. To provide the appropriate level of focus for every customer, CSMs are specialized in one of the following segments:

  • Mass - SMEs or large businesses starting their journey with Canonical
  • Focus - Large companies with established ARR
  • Step Growth - a selection of high-potential customers

All CSMs contribute to business support at the company level for all remaining, not-yet-assigned customers (Tech segment), including our Store customers.

Location: This role will be based remotely.

What your day will look like

  • Onboard new customers and introduce them to our products and support processes. Products include: Ubuntu Pro, MAAS, Landscape, Openstack, Ceph, Kubernetes, data applications and many more.
  • Elaborate and coordinate complex projects in interaction with developers, IT managers and decision makers from various industries.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Field Engineering and Support in developing and delivering engagement plans that fulfill the customer's objectives.
  • Manage a portfolio of customers in a specific geographic region and identify growth opportunities or renewal risks in coordination with Sales.
  • Experience running a disciplined, weekly customer and business review process with cross-functional teams, identifying and prioritizing blockers, and driving resolution through corporate product and engineering teams
  • Serve as a customer advocate internally and influence Canonical products roadmaps, Canonical websites, documentation, processes and people to improve customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Supporting customers through reactive ticket requests.
  • Create campaigns targeting multiple customers through digital touch-points and activities.

What we are looking for in you

The ideal candidate would display impeccable customer-facing skills with a passion for cloud and data centre infrastructure technologies. We are also looking for:

  • Minimum 5 years of work experience with a strong relation to IT and with exposure to projects related to at least one of these topics: Linux OS, data applications, storage, cloud computing, networking, security, migration, IoT.
  • Excellent presentation skills with the ability to guide a conversation about complex software.
  • Experience building and improving internal processes while maintaining timely delivery to customer-related projects.
  • A true team player capable of interacting with all departments and at all levels, both internally and externally.
  • Knowledge of agile methodologies.
  • We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Spanish and Portuguese alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us!

Additional skills that you might also bring

  • Experience with Salesforce, Jira and CRMs is a big plus!

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

Department Technical & Infrastructure

Location Brazil

THE POSITION

The Venue Design Manager reports to FIFA27 Head of Infrastructure & Technical Services and FIFA Senior Venue Design Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. The FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™ requires venue design as a key central delivery to fully integrate and visually represent all operations, legacy information and complementary structures required for the tournament. The Venue Design Manager is responsible for leading and implementing the venue design from block planning through to final design across a cluster of official FIFA stadiums and venues. Role to transition into onsite Venue Overlay Manager during final Event.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Reception, validation and conversion of raw data into clean base CADs
  • Drawing updates according to FIFA standards and templates (layers, colour codes, line styles, annotation, legends, layouts, naming conventions etc.)

  • Management and interaction of central database for drawing development, communication, change requests and publications.
  • Application of requirements according to FIFA Event Platform (EP) and venue limitations.
  • Delivery of drawings sets according to inspections and project timelines (site plans, levels, seating maps, pitch plans, catwalks, sections, detailed layouts etc.)
  • Continuous collaboration and support for Venue Management and FIFA Functional Areas.
  • Collaborate with the Technical Services and Overlay teams, Functional Areas, stadium authorities, and other stakeholders to define, optimize and validate solutions, ensuring technical requirements are accurately reflected in designs and BoQs.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Degree in architecture, engineering, urban planning or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience managing multi-venue overlay projects, from design to delivery, preferably for major sporting events (e.g., FIFA, Olympic Games).
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, BIM 360, Adobe Creative Cloud and Microsoft Office tools.
  • Strong technical knowledge in temporary infrastructure and spatial planning.
